name: Simon's Auto Keyword Linker
author: Simon Ward

sections.description:
**Simon’s Auto Keyword Linker is a lightweight, fast, and powerful internal linking tool that automatically converts your selected keywords into do-follow links across your entire site.

Perfect for building glossaries, topic clusters, authority hubs, or simply improving internal linking for SEO — without any bloat.

Now improved with smart external link handling — you decide: keep internal links dofollow (great for SEO), while external links automatically open in a new tab with rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer" for security and best practice.

Perfect for:
– Building topic clusters & authority hubs
– Creating glossary or dictionary pages
– Automating internal linking at scale
– Managing affiliate or partner links safely

Key Features:

– Unlimited keyword → URL pairs
– Option to link each keyword 1–50 times per post/page
– Only first occurrence per keyword by default (or more if you choose)
– Never links a keyword on its own target page (prevents self-linking)
– Case-insensitive, whole-word matching
– Skips existing links, headings, and HTML tags
– Sorted by keyword length to prevent partial/overlapping matches
– Clean, fast regex-based engine
– Fully compatible with page builders, Gutenberg, and classic editor
– New: Option to open external links in a new tab + add rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"
– Internal links remain rel="dofollow" (SEO-friendly)

Ideal for niche sites, authority blogs, glossary sections, and large content sites.

Example usage:

Web Hosting|https://yourwebsite.com/web-hosting/
External URL|https://url.com (external — will open in new tab + nofollow if enabled)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simons-auto-keyword-linker folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Keyword Links
  4. Add your keyword|URL pairs (one per line)
  5. Optional: Set max links per keyword and enable “Open external links in new tab + nofollow”
